stemMd: A retailer plans to reduce packaging because customers say they prefer less waste. The plan assumes that simpler packaging will not make customers think the product is damaged. Which finding challenges that assumption?

options.label: A
options.textMd: The retailer’s website has a waste-reduction page.

options.label: B
options.textMd: In a trial, many customers interpreted the simpler packaging as evidence the product had been opened.

options.label: C
options.textMd: Customers can carry the product in a bag.

options.label: D
options.textMd: The product is sold in three sizes.

explanationMd: The assumption concerns how customers interpret the simpler package. Trial participants associating it with prior opening directly threatens that premise. The finding does not prove waste reduction is undesirable, but it reveals a possible obstacle to the plan.

distractorRationale.e: This is compatible with favouring less packaging.
distractorRationale.d: Size variety does not challenge the perception assumption.
distractorRationale.a: A webpage does not show customer interpretation of the new package.
distractorRationale.c: Portability does not address perceptions of damage or opening.
